name: Kaufland
verdict: Kaufland is a retail company of the family-owned German Schwarz Group (with Lidl). No state in the chain, no human-rights finding against the company. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: propose 'none'. The link: Kaufland is one of the two retail companies of the Schwarz Group (claim kaufland-schwarz-ownership, gruppe.schwarz). The Schwarz Group is family-owned (Dieter Schwarz, via the Schwarz Stiftung) — no state in the chain, and no human-rights finding against the company was found. On the shirt: Kaufland's red square logo is the centre-front sponsor of Romania's current O'Neills home shirt (official product photo, O'Neills shop, linked from rugbyromania.ro).
